description: Apply a non-empty fields object (summary, description, assignee, labels, custom fields, ...) to an existing Jira issue by key. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the update being applied; the confirmation is delivered when the job completes. Write action.
embedding_description: Edit fields on an existing Jira issue by key: change its summary or description, reassign it, adjust labels, or set custom fields through a non-empty fields object. Dispatches asynchronously, returning a job_id immediately; the saved-change confirmation arrives via job completion. In-place field maintenance on a ticket whose key is already known.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the update confirmation -- that arrives separately when the job completes and is delivered as its own message.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the update was queued -- do not present job_id/status as proof the fields were saved. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the save confirmation lands in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, confirm which issue was updated. This mutates a real ticket's fields, so be explicit that the change was saved.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Update fields on an existing Jira issue.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: jira.bad_request: a field name/value is invalid for this issue (unknown field, wrong shape, or a value the screen does not allow). jira.not_found: the issue key does not exist. jira.invalid_params: 'fields' was missing or empty. jira.permission_denied: the account cannot edit this issue.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: jira.bad_request: verify field names and value shapes (Jira fields are often nested objects). jira.invalid_params: pass a non-empty 'fields' object. jira.not_found: confirm the issue key.
